# The JB Residence

> Independent property guide for Johor Bahru, Malaysia, written by Sam Tee, a registered real estate negotiator (REN 80322). The site explains how to choose between areas, townships and projects. Main focus: landed homes in Iskandar Puteri. It also covers Forest City, JB Town near CIQ and RTS, foreign-buyer rules, MM2H and schools.

Contact: WhatsApp +60 11-5634 8518. About the author: https://thejbresidence.com/about-sam-tee

## Area guides

- [Iskandar Puteri](https://thejbresidence.com/iskandar-puteri): landed property buyer's hub covering Eco Botanic, Horizon Hills, East Ledang, Sunway City, Estuari and Bandar Wawari
- [Johor Bahru Town](https://thejbresidence.com/jb-town): city-centre and walk-to-CIQ/RTS homes
- [Forest City](https://thejbresidence.com/forest-city): Special Financial Zone, island living and what buyers should check
- [All buyer guides](https://thejbresidence.com/articles)
- [Project shortlist](https://thejbresidence.com/projects)
